text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Gastroenteritis (likely infectious or food-borne etiology). The patient presents with watery diarrhea, abdominal cramping, and discomfort, with normal calprotectin and negative stool cytomegalovirus findings, which makes inflammatory bowel disease and CMV colitis less likely.
